summary: A study aid for the Life in the UK Test that turns revision into a game and tells you when you're ready to book.
decisions: An installable PWA with all learning and progress state on the client in Zustand, so it works offline once installed.
Questions follow the real exam's format, so practice and the test feel the same.
A readiness model tracks accuracy per topic and says when you're prepared, rather than leaving you to guess.
